# ubiops_instance_type_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing UbiOps instance type group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ubiops_instance_type_group" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  id           = "group-uuid"
}

output "instance_type_group_name" {
  value = data.ubiops_instance_type_group.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the instance type group (UUID)
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types_json` (String) A list of instance types that are in this group
- `name` (String) Name of the instance type group
- `time_created` (String) The date when the instance type group was created
